item.title: Strobe 1.1.0
item.description:
• Sensor experiments: collect data from Vernier Go Direct sensors over Bluetooth, or USB on the Mac. File › New Sensor Experiment (Command-N).
  • Time Based runs with a trigger, Events with Entry (type a value such as a mass or volume for each point), Selected Events, and photogate timing (gate, pendulum, pulse, picket fence).
  • Compare runs on one graph; analyse a stretch with the integral (impulse), statistics, a tangent or a fit, with IB error bars and max/min lines.
  • Pretend sensors to try it without one, and sensor experiments open on the iPhone too.
  • A 19-page guide for teachers and students comes in the download.
